title: Normalized finite scalar and etale-origin transport to constant coefficient modules
statement: Use constant-coefficient module sheaves and strict towers [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations], with exact open extension [def-cbc-strict-tower-open-extension]. Let $\varphi:B\to\Lambda$ be a ring homomorphism to a finite commutative ring. Realize fixed $\Lambda$-module pro-etale sheaves as modules over the continuous-function finite coefficient sheaf [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], then restrict scalars along the canonical map sending $b$ to the constant function $\varphi(b)$ [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Call this exact functor $C_X$. Its underlying additive sheaf comparison is normalized to send each sheafification-unit section to itself. The direct-image comparison is the unique isomorphism acting identically on the same pulled-back sections under this identification. Put $H_X= C_X\nu_X^*$ for the canonical etale/pro-etale inverse image [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. The comparison $H_Y f_*^{et}\to f_* H_X$ is the composite of the mate of the canonical site pullback comparison [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback], [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate] and the preceding sectionwise scalar comparison. Its inverse mate defines the inverse-image comparison, and the inverse of the open-adjunction inverse mate defines the forward open-extension comparison; the derived direct-image comparison is the right-derived unit-normalized descent of this same arrow. For an unbounded derived constant-coefficient module $K$, a scalar etale origin consists of such a ring $\Lambda$, map $\varphi$, a bounded-below finite-coefficient object with its recorded etale-origin witness [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], and an isomorphism from its scalar restriction to $K$. Forgetting commutativity from commutative ring sheaves to ring sheaves commutes with sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], with its canonical unit-preserving comparison.
